sentences.en: Eventually the salesman persuaded me to buy the expensive machine.
sentences.zh: 最终那个推销员说服我买了那台昂贵的机器。

sentences.en: He worked so hard that eventually he made himself ill.
sentences.zh: 他工作如此辛苦，以至于最后累病了。

sentences.en: We'll eventually find a solution to this problem, I think.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们最终会找到解决这个问题的方法。
